cns.text: Dack Fayden is a thief and planeswalker, whose spark flares when he and Marsh pick a fight with ruffians, Marsh is killed by a sword and Dack is struck down.
While stealing an artifact on Alkabah he is beaten by a guardian Djinn and imprisoned, where his hand is stained red.
He returns to Drakeston to find the town massacred, including Mariel, and he steals a dagger from the Cult of Rakdos and learns it was held by Sifa Grent, who murdered Drakeston.
